local_context.value: NWS Tampa Bay: the rainy season runs May 25 to October 10 for West Central Florida outside Southwest Florida, peaks July through early September; heavy rainfall, frequent lightning, and from late May through June hail and damaging winds are common. Wikipedia (Polk City, Florida) classes the climate as humid subtropical (Cfa), with hot, humid summers and generally mild to cool winters, and describes the terrain as flatland interspersed with gently rolling hills in the Central Florida Highlands; State Road 33 crosses the Green Swamp north of the city.

neighborhoods.value: Mount Olive Shores, Mount Olive Shores North, Country Trails (named as Polk City neighborhoods on Redfin's Polk City pages; not confirmed by an official page; Polk City has fewer than 4 verified, so name them in local context only)

place_entities.value: Fantasy of Flight (aviation attraction, closed as a daily attraction April 2014; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fantasy_of_Flight, Wikidata Q1395903); General James A. Van Fleet State Trail (southern trailhead in Polk City, 7683 Berkley Road; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_James_A._Van_Fleet_State_Trail, Wikidata Q5531967); Midtown Park (hosts the annual Founder's Day festival, at the start of the Van Fleet Trail; no Wikipedia/Wikidata entry; named in Wikipedia Polk City article); Green Swamp (Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Swamp, Wikidata Q5603263; SR 33 crosses it north of Polk City)
